body.p: Application Serial No.: 17/841,153 Attorney Docket 1179-058USU1 LISTING OF CLAIMS This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended.) A method for fueling and using an aircraft, wherein the method comprises:
storing, using a fuel tank, liquified gas fuel;
fueling, using a fuel line, an aircraft, wherein fueling further comprises:
filling the fuel tank with liquified gas fuel to a desired level, wherein the desired level comprises fuel for a plurality of flights plus reserves, wherein a sensor connected to the fuel tank detects at least abnormal phenomena related to the fuel tank, wherein the sensor converts the detected at least abnormal phenomena into a signal that is then transmitted to a computing device; and
removing, using the computing device, the fuel line as function of the desired level in the aircraft; and
preparing the fuel tank for flight as a function of the desired level; and
flying, using the aircraft, a plurality of flights using the liquid gas fuel.
2. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein the aircraft comprises a blended wing body aircraft.
3. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein the fuel tank is configured to have a multi- lobe geometry.
4. (Original.) The method of claim 3, wherein the fuel tank comprises a septum.
5. (Currently Amended.) The method of claim 3, wherein the multi-lobe geometry provides tension for each container fuel tank of the multi-lobe geometry.
6. (Currently Amended.) The method of claim 1, wherein the fuel tank is prepared as a function of a fill datum flight status.
7. (Original.) The method of claim 1, further comprising venting, using a vent line, the fuel tank, wherein the vent line is in fluid connection to the fuel tank.

8. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the vent line is configured to capture gaseous hydrogen from the fuel tank.
9. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the vent line is configured to release pressure from the fuel tank.
10. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the vent line includes a pressure regulator.
11. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the vent line is insulated to prevent the accumulation of frozen gases.
12. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the vent line includes an inner wall and an outer wall wherein a void resides in between.
13. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the vent line further comprises a heat exchanger.
14. (Original.) The method of claim 7, wherein the preparing the fuel tank for flight further includes detaching the vent line from the fuel tank as a function of the desired level.
15. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein the preparing of the fuel tank for flight further includes detaching the fuel line from the fuel tank as a function of the desired level.
16. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein the plurality of flights are further configured to:
commence at a first refueling station; and
terminate at a second refueling station.
17. (Currently Amended.) The method of claim 1, wherein substantially no fueling occurs between the flights of the plurality of flights.
18. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein fueling occurs over a period of time, exceeding 30 minutes.
19. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein the fuel tank may comprise a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the tank.
20. (Original.) The method of claim 1, wherein the liquified gas fuel is comprised of liquid hydrogen.
